mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary stance that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% coincident with a housing starts (HOUST) contraction of more than 10% month-over-month triggers a demand shock that depresses earnings expectations and results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY change < -2% AND HOUST MoM change < -10%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly below zero at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market that amplifies wage growth and input costs, compressing profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly industrial production (INDPRO) contraction of more than 1% for four consecutive months indicates a broad-based supply chain weakness that reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO MoM change < -1% for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 30% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the 10-year Treasury yield (not directly observed, but implied by FEDFUNDS trajectory and CPIAUCSL dynamics) below 3.5% combined with rising CPIAUCSL above 3% YoY signals a low-rate environment with rising inflation, which erodes real equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% AND FEDFUNDS trajectory implies 10Y yield < 3.5%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly below zero at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in real personal savings (RSAFS) above 5% coincident with a decline in personal consumption expenditures growth (implied from GDPC1) below 1% signals a precautionary savings surge that reduces near-term consumption and earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS MoM change > 5% AND GDPC1 MoM change < 1%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) increase below 50,000 for two consecutive months signals a stalling labor market that foreshadows weaker consumer spending and corporate profits, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS MoM change < 50,000 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly housing starts (HOUST) level below 1,500,000 units signals a persistent housing market downturn that reduces construction-related earnings and confidence, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly below zero at 95% confidence.
